{"id":1903111716,"question_id":4200,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1769870630,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1903111716/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Reverse Letters Then Special Characters in a String","memory":"9.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string reverseByType(string s) {\n        vector<char>letters , special;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<s.size() ; i++){\n            char ch = s[i];\n            if(ch >= 'a' and ch <= 'z') letters.push_back(s[i]);\n            else special.push_back(s[i]);\n        }\n\n        reverse(letters.begin() , letters.end());\n        reverse(special.begin() , special.end());\n\n        int a = 0 , b = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<s.size() ; i++){\n            char ch = s[i];\n            if(ch >= 'a' and ch <= 'z') s[i] = letters[a++];\n            else s[i] = special[b++];\n        }\n        return s;\n\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"reverse-letters-then-special-characters-in-a-string","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1608}
